project: taskq, a sample job-queue library used only in this lesson

quickstart.title: Quickstart
quickstart.body:
# Quickstart

Create a queue with `Queue("emails")` and add a job with `queue.put(job)`. Start a worker with `taskq worker emails`. A worker takes one job at a time and acknowledges it when the handler returns.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.body:
# Configuration

Set `TASKQ_BROKER_URL` to the broker address. `visibility_timeout` is the number of seconds a job stays hidden after a worker takes it; the default is 30. Set it longer than your slowest handler, or a second worker takes the same job.

retries.title: Retries
retries.body:
# Retries

A handler that raises is retried up to `max_retries` times, 3 by default, with exponential backoff. After the last attempt the job moves to the dead-letter queue. Make handlers idempotent: a retried job can run twice.
